# National Archives Strategic Plan

[FY 2026-2030 Strategic PlanFramework](https://www.archives.gov/files/about/plans-reports/strategic-plan/strategic-plan-framework-2026-2030.pdf)

The National Archives is drafting its 2026-2030 Strategic Plan. This Strategic Plan Framework articulates clearly our mission, vision, values, and high-level goals. This document is the starting point for the development of the full plan and our roadmap for the future.

## Our Past Strategic Plans

- [2022-2026 Plan](https://www.archives.gov/files/about/plans-reports/strategic-plan/nara-2022-2026-strategic-plan-march-2022.pdf) ( [HTML version](https://www.archives.gov/about/plans-reports/strategic-plan/strategic-plan-2022-2026))
